text:
A savage axe warrior whose rage grows through combat.

Primary: STR | Secondary: CON

MP mechanic: MP = Rage, builds only from hitting mobs, decays when not fighting - higher rage means more passive damage on every hit. Never spend it, just maintain it.

Skills:
Cyclone - spin 8 directions hitting adjacent mobs, evolves to 16 hits at max level
Thunderstrike - massive overhead AoE slam
Vampiric Strike - heals 40% of damage dealt
Broad Swipe - hit front + east + west tiles
Intimidating Shout - fear nearby mobs, they flee
Flatten - single target stun
Axe Block - 3 second invulnerability
Berserker Charge - 2-tile rush hits all in path
